annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously refers to the :authority pseudo‑header field (as established in the preceding clause) and specifies that it must be omitted when translating an HTTP/1.1 request whose target is in origin or asterisk form. The reference to Section 3.2 of [HTTP11] further clarifies the intended behavior, leaving no materially different implementation interpretations or missing constraints.
